standalone_contracts.20_hard_wall_alpha3_purification: Independent hard-wall alpha1=3 Born purification control at Nx=20, Ny=40: 100 maximally mixed trajectories through 160 perfect-correction cycles, fixed 40+40+20 covariance batches, 38 decimal-GB device budget with <=35-GB allocator ceiling, every-cycle entropy/contours/occupations/Born weights, final covariances, twenty five-sample shards and ten-cycle scientific checkpoints; no migration or postselection.

descriptions.27_square_hard_wall_random_center_chern: Independent square hard-wall Chern sweep: Nx=Ny=20,30,40, S100 per size, exactly 40 cycles; ten distinct periodic random y centers per sample/cycle at x=L/2 and R=0.2L, nshell1 perfect correction, slab-only raster-y dynamics, final occupied frames, calibrated A100 execution batches and completion-based resume. Does not reuse bundle23 data.
descriptions.26_fixed_width_hard_wall_gap_t40: Independent fixed-width and fixed-time hard-wall gap pilot: Nx=20, Ny=20,24,28,32,36,40,44,48, ten maximally mixed Born trajectories per size, exactly forty physical cycles, slab-only measurements and Born-conditioned exterior preparation. Endpoint active occupation spectra and all finite-rate complex128 eigenvectors with spatial basis maps, raw modular gaps and gaps divided by 80, five-cycle covariance/RNG checkpoints, sixteen five-sample result shards, and ordinary sample SEM.
descriptions.25_square_hard_wall_gap_pilot: Fixed-time square hard-wall purification pilot: Nx=Ny=20,24,28,32,36,40,44, ten independent maximally mixed trajectories per size and ten physical cycles, original slab-only protocol with Born-conditioned exterior preparation, endpoint active occupation spectra only, five-cycle covariance/RNG checkpoints, and fourteen five-sample shards. Analysis reports both raw modular gaps and gaps divided by 2T=20 with ordinary trajectory SEM; no asymptotic exponent claim.
descriptions.24_flattened_imaginary_time_density: CPU deterministic half-filled signed OW-parent ground state, Nx20 Ny30 hard walls alpha1=1 alpha2=30 nshell1: exact local and column density autocorrelations at tau=0 plus 240 logarithmic delays, consistent 1e-7 occupation regulator, no circuit trajectories or Monte Carlo errors. Overrides the parent GPU/Markov-entry-point defaults; canonical CPU OW construction only.
descriptions.23_hard_wall_random_center_chern: Independent S100 hard-wall pure-state Chern dynamics at Nx=20 and Ny=20,30,40 through 2Ny cycles; ten freshly sampled distinct periodic y centers per trajectory/cycle at x=10, R=4; batched frame-native contractions, final frames/ranks, measured A100 batch calibration and execution-batch completion resume.
descriptions.01_uniform_bulk_validation: Independent S100 uniform topological campaign through L=24: DW off, pure initialization, perfect correction, complex128, and compact Chern/charge observations at t=0..40.
descriptions.02_domain_wall_bipartite_mutual_informat: Independent S100 domain-wall mutual-information sweep at Nx=20 and Ny=20,24,28: quarter-width opposite strips, 21 alpha_1 values ordered from 3 down to 1, hard/soft constructions, endpoint 2Ny observations, aggressive 50/25/25-trajectory GPU macros, and read-only import of checksum-verified five-sample v1 outputs.
descriptions.03_uniform_bulk_validation_large_l: Closed 2026-09-09: complete S100 L=28,32 cells extend the accepted balanced uniform bulk-validation grid through L=32. Partial L=36 data are preserved as supporting evidence; remaining L=36 and all L=40 work are retired and must not be resumed for the current paper plan.
descriptions.04_maxmix_manybody_lyapunov_pilot: Independent S100 hard-wall max-mix Lyapunov pilot at Nx=20 and Ny=20,22,24,26,28,30,36,40: perfect-correction covariance dynamics, active-space occupation spectra, record free energy, and preliminary finite-size coefficients.
descriptions.05_hard_wall_entropy_charge_batched_v2: Two disjoint A100 lanes for an independent S100 hard-wall endpoint campaign at Nx=20 and Ny=30,35,40,45,50,55,60: 2Ny perfect-correction dynamics, batched endpoint S1/S2/S3 and intrinsic charge variance, one fixed half-strip contour per size, five-cycle dynamics resume, and per-width endpoint resume. The v1 design is quarantined as superseded for performance.
descriptions.06_domain_wall_flattened_ground_state_re: Local CPU complex128 sweeps of the exact half-filled ground state of the hard/support-truncated and soft/untruncated flattened parent at Nx=20: the completed Ny=20,24,28 nshell=1 reference plus a separate Ny=40,50,60 and nshell=1,2,inf extension on the 21-point descending alpha_1 grid, with opposite-strip mutual information, log-chord central-charge fits, geometry, diagnostics, and completed figures/data. A deterministic Nx=20, Ny=60, alpha_1=1 analysis resolves counterpropagating wall dispersions, assigns c_fit=1/2 to each wall through the pure-state entropy contour, and verifies the finite-ring chiral correlator.
descriptions.07_maxmix_hard_soft_purification: Corrected v3 hard- and soft-wall A100 notebooks for S100 maximally mixed purification at Nx=20 and Ny=20,30,40 through 4Ny cycles, with every-cycle occupation spectra, absolute Born-record log probability, cell-resolved entropy/charge-fluctuation contours, final covariance matrices, rolling ten-cycle checkpoints, and exact read-only import of identity-pinned v2 checkpoints. V2 is quarantined after its explicit-covariance continuation was incorrectly rejected when trajectories had heterogeneous purity.
descriptions.08_domain_wall_correlator_scaling: Independent hard- and soft-wall S100 correlator scaling at Nx=20 and Ny=24,28,32 for alpha_1=1,3 and nshell=1,2,dense: pure perfect-correction raster-y dynamics through 2Ny, every-cycle frame-native wall correlators and total charge, and rolling 16-cycle checkpoints.
descriptions.09_pure_tangent_replay_acquisition: Replay-complete S100 pure physical trajectories at Nx=20 and Ny=24,28,32 for hard/soft walls and alpha_1=1,3, plus an optional aggressively batched A100 tangent-replay notebook using 25 saved trajectories per GPU task.
descriptions.10_soft_wall_entropy_charge_batched_v2: Two disjoint A100 lanes for an independent S100 soft/untruncated-wall endpoint campaign at Nx=20 and Ny=30,35,40,45,50,55,60: full-layer 2Ny perfect-correction dynamics, batched endpoint S1/S2/S3 and intrinsic charge variance, one fixed half-strip contour per size, five-cycle dynamics resume, and per-width endpoint resume.
descriptions.11_wall_pump_width_endpoints: Independent A100 endpoint acquisition for wall-pump width scaling at Ny=24: 1,000 missing S100 endpoints over nshell=1 and dense Nx cells plus a 150-endpoint CPU/GPU bridge, hard/soft walls, 48-cycle raster-y perfect-correction dynamics, benchmark-selected execution batching, five-sample durable shards, and rolling five-cycle checkpoints.
descriptions.12_wall_diabatic_spectral_pump_gpu: Aggressively concurrent A100 complex128 port of the M=256 wall-diabatized primary spectral-flow calculation over existing endpoint states: benchmark-selected 1/2/4/8 endpoint lanes with an 8-GiB headroom gate, strict Drive input inventory, mandatory CPU/GPU eigensystem parity, task-level resume, local-scratch atomic publication, unchanged result schema, and no 2,050-task sensitivity suite.
descriptions.13_maxmix_manybody_lyapunov_4ny: Corrected v4 hard-wall S100 many-body Lyapunov acquisition at Nx=20 and Ny=20,24,30,36,44,56,60 through 4Ny, split operationally across disjoint A100 lanes A={60,44,20} and B={56,36,30,24}: memory-scaled complex128 covariance batches under a 38-GiB PyTorch allocator ceiling, every-cycle Born-record weights, selected active occupation spectra and leading log(sigma^2) levels, five-trajectory durable result shards, rolling ten-cycle state/RNG/observer checkpoints, and per-task peak-memory telemetry. The lane notebooks preserve the v4 scientific source/configuration identity and existing Ny=60 checkpoint.
descriptions.14_hard_wall_xresolved_correlator_scalin: Independent S100 hard-wall x-resolved correlator extension at Nx=20 and Ny=40,50,60: alpha_1=1, alpha_2=30, nshell=1, pure raster-y perfect-correction dynamics through 2Ny, v2 doubles large-size A100 residency under a strict 30-GiB allocator ceiling, saves final-time correlators plus reconstructible occupied frames/ranks and the covariance and occupation spectrum of A=[0,Nx)x[0,Ny//2), and retains five-sample durable shards with rolling five-cycle checkpoints.
descriptions.15_hard_wall_alpha3_xresolved_correlator: Matched alpha_1=3 hard-wall-only S100 endpoint correlators at Nx=20, Ny=60, alpha_2=30, nshell=1: pure raster-y perfect-correction complex128 dynamics through 120 cycles, 40+40+20 resident batches under a 30-GiB allocator limit, twenty five-sample correlator/charge shards, native notebook progress and rolling five-cycle state/RNG checkpoints. No endpoint frames, covariance matrices or spectra.
descriptions.16_hard_wall_entropy_contour_all_ay: Independent S100 hard-wall endpoint campaign at Nx=20 and Ny=30,35,40,45,50,55,60: per-trajectory von Neumann contours for every full-x strip width after exact within-trajectory averaging over all periodic origins, retained v2 scalar entropy/charge curves, five-cycle dynamics resume, per-width endpoint resume, and ordinary trajectory-SEM analysis of the two physical walls.
descriptions.17_hard_wall_tangent_gap_cocycle: Execution v2 of the two-lane S100 hard-wall pure-state tangent campaign at Nx=20: unchanged 67-case science and trajectory-first quenched gaps, smaller 25/20/15/10/10-trajectory restart units after a Ny=40 v1 batch took 1.70 hours, read-only exact import of its saved 25 cocycles, and a new v2 output collection while preserving v1.
descriptions.18_hard_wall_purification_alpha_endpoint: Two disjoint A100 lanes for 14,700 hard-wall maximally mixed trajectories at Nx=20, Ny=24,28,32,36,40,44,50 and 21 alpha_1 values through 2Ny: aggressively resident complex128 covariance batches under a 38-GiB allocator ceiling, ten-cycle state/RNG checkpoints, endpoint-only occupation-derived single-particle Lyapunov gaps, Ny=50 centered spectra and interior eigenvectors, and five-trajectory checksum-bound result shards.
descriptions.19_postselected_hard_soft_n20x40: One A100 notebook: hard then soft at alpha_1=1, then hard then soft at alpha_1=3, Nx=20 Ny=40 through 4Ny. Every-cycle cell and x-resolved entropy contours, total entropy and gaps; endpoint spectra/eigenvectors and ten-cycle state/RNG/contour checkpoints. Independent v2 output folder preserves v1.
descriptions.28_full_measurement_purification_gap_t40: Nx20, Ny30,36,42,48,54,60, S100, hard walls alpha1=1 alpha2=30, full-measurement global-maxmix covariance dynamics (meas_slab_only=False), forty cycles. Per-sample full spectra, gaps normalized by 2t and all finite-mode eigenvectors at cycles6..40; five-cycle state/RNG checkpoints, GPU-tuned 1/2/5-matrix spectral batches and 4,200 five-sample/cycle pairs. V2 retains the v1 dynamics batch table/seeds with a separate output folder; no slab-only imports.
